job.title: Health & Safety Manager (HSE Manager)
job.description:
Health, Safety & Environmental (HS&E) Manager

Tipperary | 12 Month Fixed-Term Contract | Generous Salary Package

We're recruiting an experienced Health, Safety & Environmental (HS&E) Manager to join a leading manufacturing company in Tipperary/Midlands on a 12-month fixed-term contract.

Reporting to the HR Manager, you'll take ownership of the site's Health, Safety & Environmental function, ensuring compliance with legislation while driving a positive safety culture across the business. This is a fantastic opportunity to join a well-established manufacturing operation and make a real impact.

The Role

  • Lead the site's Health, Safety & Environmental Management System.

  • Ensure compliance with all Health & Safety and Environmental legislation.

  • Carry out risk assessments, audits and workplace inspections.

  • Investigate accidents, incidents and near misses, implementing corrective and preventative actions.

  • Deliver Health & Safety inductions and coordinate mandatory training programmes.

  • Develop and maintain Safe Operating Procedures (SOPs) and safe systems of work.

  • Chair Health & Safety Committee meetings and promote employee engagement.

  • Monitor environmental compliance, including chemical storage, emissions and waste management.

  • Coordinate emergency response procedures, fire drills and statutory requirements.

  • Prepare Health & Safety reports, KPIs and compliance documentation.

  • Liaise with insurers and external bodies regarding workplace incidents and claims.

  • Support GDPR compliance across the organisation.

About You

  • Health & Safety qualification (NEBOSH, Diploma, Degree or equivalent).

  • Previous Health & Safety experience within manufacturing, food production or an industrial environment.

  • Strong knowledge of Irish Health & Safety legislation and compliance requirements.

  • Experience conducting audits, investigations and risk assessments.

  • Manual Handling Instructor qualification would be an advantage.

What's on Offer

  • Generous salary package.

  • 12-month fixed-term contract.

  • Monday to Friday role with standard daytime hours.

  • Opportunity to join a well-established manufacturing business.

  • Supportive leadership team and positive working environment.

  • Immediate start available for the right candidate.

If you're an experienced Health & Safety professional looking for your next challenge in a manufacturing environment, we'd love to hear from you.

job.title: Accounts Portfolio Manager
job.description:
Accounts Portfolio Manager

Location: Limerick | Office-based
Reporting to: Partner / Director

The Opportunity

We are working with a rapidly expanding professional services firm in Limerick that is looking to appoint an experienced Accounts Portfolio Manager to join its growing team.

This is an excellent opportunity for a qualified accountant with strong practice experience who enjoys working closely with clients, managing a varied portfolio and supporting the development of junior team members.

The successful candidate will manage a portfolio of clients across the Mid-West business community, providing high-quality accounting and advisory support while working closely with the firm's senior leadership team.

A strong understanding of the business environment across the Mid-West is an essential part of the role.

Key Responsibilities

  • Manage a varied portfolio of clients, acting as a key point of contact and trusted financial adviser.
  • Oversee the preparation and review of accounts and financial statements.
  • Provide accounting, compliance and advisory support to clients.
  • Ensure client assignments and statutory deadlines are completed accurately and on time.
  • Review work prepared by junior members of the accounts team and provide technical guidance and support.
  • Manage workflow across the portfolio, working with the wider accounts team to ensure deadlines and client requirements are met.
  • Build and maintain strong, long-term client relationships.
  • Identify opportunities to add value to clients through additional accounting and advisory services.
  • Work closely with the Partner/Director on client matters and business development.
  • Support the development and mentoring of junior members of the team.
  • Contribute to the continued growth and development of the practice.

About You

The ideal candidate will be:

  • A qualified accountant – ACA, ACCA or equivalent.
  • Experienced within an accountancy practice environment.
  • Comfortable managing a portfolio of clients and taking ownership of client relationships.
  • Technically strong with good knowledge of accounting and financial reporting.
  • Experienced in reviewing accounts and the work of more junior team members.
  • Commercially aware with a good understanding of the Mid-West business environment.
  • A strong communicator who enjoys working directly with clients.
  • Organised and capable of managing multiple priorities and deadlines.
  • A confident team player with the ability to support and develop junior colleagues.

The Team

You will join an established accounts function of 8 team members, with the wider team deployed across different client portfolios depending on workload and demand.

The Accounts Portfolio Manager will report directly to the Partner/Director, providing an excellent opportunity to work closely with senior leadership and play an important role in the continued growth of the practice.

Excellent salary plus benefits

job.title: Visual Inspection Specialist - Sterile Injectables

Responsibilities will include:

  • Applying AQL principles and defect-classification standards.
  • Supporting Quality Operations and shopfloor quality activities.
  • Contributing to CAPA investigations and inspection-readiness activities.

Requirements

  • Proven pharmaceutical visual inspection experience involving sterile or injectable products.
  • Strong knowledge of AQL and defect classification.
  • Experience within a GMP-regulated manufacturing environment.
  • Strong GMP and GxP documentation skills.
  • Experience updating SOPs and preparing technical rationales.

Apply now or contact Kerry Rickard for further information.
